title: Solid Core vs. Foam Core DWV Pipe Selection
description: Understanding the distinction between solid core and cellular core Schedule 40 PVC is essential for durable drainage installations. Solid core PVC features uniform plastic throughout the pipe wall, offering high structural strength and superior impact resistance suitable for high-stress underground or commercial applications. Foam core PVC consists of solid outer skin layers sandwiching a lightweight expanded core, reducing overall weight and cost for standard residential above-ground drainage lines. Always verify local code approvals and job site conditions prior to material selection.
